plugins.name: debian-preseed-di-new
plugins.description: Repository-specific workflow for the Debian Installer preseed tree, class and profile policy, tracked target mirrors, and focused smoke tests.

interface.longDescription: Use this plugin for source-first changes in the Debian Installer preseed repository, including class and profile policy, installer-stage scripts, tracked target mirrors, and focused repository tests.
defaultPrompt: Use the Debian Preseed DI plugin for a focused installer repository change.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Repository-specific workflow for the Codex Rust workspace, CLI, SDKs, generated configuration schema, and project validation commands.

interface.longDescription: Use this plugin for focused work in the Codex source repository with nested instruction discovery, source-versus-generated boundaries, just-based formatting and testing, and configuration-schema synchronization.
defaultPrompt: Use the Codex Repository plugin for a focused source change and validation.

plugins.name: disk-manager
plugins.description: Repository-specific workflow for disk-manager Go code, configuration, scripts, and non-destructive validation.

interface.longDescription: Use this plugin for disk-manager source changes while keeping block-device, filesystem, LUKS, NVMe, installation, and host-mutation operations outside routine validation.
defaultPrompt: Use the Disk Manager Repository plugin without touching real block devices.

plugins.name: gitops
plugins.description: Repository-specific workflow for the GitOps command suite, installer scripts, Git aliases, and protected branch operations.

interface.longDescription: Use this plugin for GitOps source changes with shell syntax validation and explicit safeguards around global Git configuration, branch promotion, mirrors, tags, repositories, and destructive cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Use the GitOps Repository plugin for a non-destructive source change.

plugins.name: key-manager
plugins.description: Repository-specific workflow for key-manager Go code and SSH, GPG, PQC, TLS, filesystem, and subprocess security boundaries.

interface.longDescription: Use this plugin for key-manager changes that preserve strict input validation, atomic file handling, symlink refusal, subprocess safety, test isolation, and secret-free repository evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use the Key Manager Repository plugin for a security-focused source change.

plugins.name: debian-usb-new
plugins.description: Repository-specific workflow for Debian USB Go, Python, shell, configuration, ISO, and removable-media tooling.

interface.longDescription: Use this plugin for Debian USB source changes with mixed-language validation and strict separation from real USB media, host installation, ISO writes, sudo, and destructive cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Use the Debian USB Repository plugin without writing to real media.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: Repository-specific workflow for shared GitLab CI verification, testing, build, stage, publish, registry, policy, and Cloudflare delivery templates.

interface.longDescription: Use this plugin for shared GitLab delivery changes while preserving namespace ownership, stage semantics, publish-mode isolation, pinned images, YAML validity, and non-publishing local validation.
defaultPrompt: Use the Delivery Repository plugin for a focused shared CI template change.
